model_annotation: The plot illustrates the loss over iterations for different models, comparing their performance. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140000, and tick labels at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", also with a linear scale, spanning from 2.4 to 3.4, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Five lines are shown, each representing a different model: Vanilla (purple, solid), StrmLLM (n=64) (orange, solid), SepLLM (n=64) (green, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H) (red, solid), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (blue, solid), and SepLLM (n=128) (pink, solid). The Vanilla line starts at approximately 3.32 and decreases to around 2.31. The StrmLLM (n=64) line begins at about 3.3 and ends at roughly 2.34. The SepLLM (n=64) line starts at approximately 3.24 and decreases to around 2.29. The SepLLM (n=64, H) line begins at about 3.23 and ends at roughly 2.28. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line starts at approximately 3.21 and decreases to around 2.27. The SepLLM (n=128) line begins at about 3.2 and ends at roughly 2.26. All lines exhibit a sharp decline initially, followed by a gradual decrease as the number of iterations increases.
